test_cases.precondition: app open on a screen carrying the member; screen allowed to settle; prior sheets closed
test_cases.action: note the on-screen context, then tap each live instance of the control in turn (every capture of the same live control is tapped as that control, in each distinct state it was captured in)
test_cases.expected_result: every X closes the page or sheet it sits on and returns to where the user came from
test_cases.confirms_if: two members in the same visual state do unrelated things and nothing visible before the tap says so
test_cases.overturns_if: every member does the same thing, or the difference is a state face or the same job scoped to its own page
test_cases.observed_result: closes the Energy page, back to home; closes the Shop page, back to home (the X is drawn faded but works); closes the Spanish Course section list, back to home; closes the Spanish Score page, back to the home screen with the course drawer open; closes the Streak page, back to home; closes the course picker, back to home; closes the unit guidebook, back to home
